_meta: English translations/summaries of the original Russian comments in default_platform_config.lua (build 1.99.0.167293). Key = cvar name. Written by the project; 'verified' status is NOT implied - see docs/05-configuration/cvar-notes.md.
auth_allowInternalAutoCreate: Allow automatic creation of an internal account on first login (bool). Set 0 to forbid new accounts.
shard_minAntibotCounterForMailSending: Minimum anti-bot counter value required to send mail (int, 0..100).
auth_infinitePremiumForRoles: Semicolon-separated list of admin roles (admRole) that have infinite premium (string).
squad_maxNonPremiumSize: Squad size that can queue without premium (int).
store_allowAllItemsForBying: Allow buying store items even if flagged cant_be_bought (bool).
gold_on_start: Starting Galactic Standards (gold) of a new account (int).
premium_on_start: Starting premium time/value of a new account (int).
credits_on_start: Starting credits of a new account (int).
store_prestigePerVssl: Prestige contribution of one regular ship. Prestige = regular*this + premium*store_prestigePerPremVssl (float).
store_prestigePerPremVssl: Prestige contribution of one premium ship; higher = premium ships raise prestige more (float).
store_vesselExpExtractionCost: Cost factor of extracting ship experience (float).
store_vesselExpExtractionCostVisualBonus: Visual bonus/indicator of the XP-extraction cost (float); set in a Lua if-branch depending on the cost value.
store_vesselPriceMod: Multiplier for ship prices (credits, premium, tokens, event price), 0.001..100 (float).
store_modulePriceMod: Multiplier for module prices (credits, premium, tokens, event price), 0.001..100 (float).
mm_squad1AsSquad: Treat a single player as a squad of one in matchmaking (bool).
mm_totalMMVMdCap: Cap on the total MMV modification from efficiency, KPM, wins and other factors.
mm_effRatingMMVMdStep: MMV-from-efficiency: step; smaller step = efficiency raises MMV faster.
mm_kpmMMVStep: MMV-from-KPM: step; smaller = KPM raises MMV faster.
mm_winLoseMMVMinBattles: Win/lose term only applies after this many battles.
mm_winLoseMMVBase: Win/lose term: base ratio. Value = clamp((winLose - Base)/Step, 0, Cap).
mm_mmvMdBattles: Per-rank battle thresholds (18 values) after which the MMV modifiers/floors apply (newbie protection).
mm_mmvMin: Per-rank lower bound of final MMV, active after the battle threshold; list length must equal mm_mmvMdBattles.
mm_mmvMdUniqFingerprintClamp: Per-rank upper bound of MMV for players with a unique PC fingerprint while they have fewer battles than the threshold.
sm_initialKeepAliveTime: Seconds to wait for the client's first keep-alive after connect; no answer = disconnect.
ctm_taskRecoveryInterval: Interval (s, 0.01..5) at which the shard polls storage for deferred admin tasks.
squad_maxNonWingSize: Max size of a regular squad that is not yet a wing; exceeding it requires a wing group.
squad_maxWingSize: Max size of a wing group.
mm_sectorMinWingSize: Min wing size to enter sector (universe) queues.
mm_sectorMaxWingSize: Max wing size for sector queues.
mm_raidMinWingSize: Min wing size to enter a raid queue.
mm_raidSquadFilter: Who may queue for raids: 0 any, 1 solo only, 2 solo+squads, 3 squads+wings, 4 wings only.
mm_notArcadeSquadRankDiff: Allowed ship-rank spread inside a squad for non-arcade modes.
raid_lootAuraInterval: Days between re-granting raid loot auras (checked at the player's first login of the day).
store_creditsEventStart: Start time of the credits event (ISO-8601 string).
store_creditsEventEnd: End time of the credits event (ISO-8601 string).
mm_decisionLog: Matchmaker decision-log bitmask: 1 PvP, 2 PvP join-in-progress, 4 PvP candidates, 8 coop, 16 coop JIP, 32 PvE, 64 universe, 128 brawl, 256 brawl candidates, 512 hunger games, 1024 one against all, 2048 zombie, 4096 three teams, 8192 close distance, 16384 general (32767 = all).
mm_decisionDbg: Decision-log output: 0 buffer and dump as one block to the info log; 1 write each message immediately to the debug log.
store_maxUniqueModules: Max number of identical unique modules per regular ship.
store_maxUniqueModulesOnPremium: Max identical unique (experimental) modules on premium/DLC ships.
sv_offerEnable: Comma/space/tab separated offerIds from offers.xml to enable on the shard; empty string disables all offers.
store_bonusBundleChancePercentageMax: Max chance of a bonus bundle when buying a bundle; scaled by prestige/maxPrestige (0..1).
premiumTimeForAccountRank: Premium time (seconds) granted per account rank (default one day).
sv_tokenCreditsDailyLimit: Daily limit of token credits (Iridium) a player can earn.
store_battlePassUnlockLvlBtnStart: Time from which the battle-pass 'unlock level' button appears (ISO-8601).
sm_bflRoleInc: Adaptive bot presets: factor increasing a BFL role (battle time for life time) statistic.
sm_bflRoleDec: Adaptive bot presets: factor decreasing a BFL role statistic.
sm_numAdaptivePresetsToSaveDB: Number of adaptive presets stored in the DB; 0 clears the data (0..1000).
cl_maxFps: Frame-rate cap of the process; 0 = unlimited. Server simulation rate is derived from it.
cl_combatLog: Combat-log verbosity written to the log: 0 off, 1 kills/deaths/rewards, 2 + module/missile/aura use, 3 + all damage, 4 + gameplay-aura parameter coefficients.
db_logMessages: Database protocol logging: 0 off, 1 brief, 2 full.
sv_respawnTimePenalty: Override of the respawn-time penalty for deaths; -1 = use gameplay settings (newbie queues force 0).
sv_afkCheckDuration: Seconds without control input before an AFK kick; a huge value (e.g. 3600) effectively disables it.
sv_lootFailChance: Probability (0..1) of finding nothing in post-battle loot.
sv_lootDuration: Duration of the loot-collection stage in seconds.
sv_salvageTokenConversion: Regular salvage: tokens refunded = item tokenPrice * this.
sv_salvagePremiumTokenConversion: Premium salvage: tokens refunded = tokenPrice * this.
sv_salvagePremiumPriceConversion: Premium salvage price = item price * this.
sv_universeWingVsWingRewardCf: Reward multiplier for wing-vs-wing BFS (universe) battles, 1..10.
ship_controlForceMode: Force a ship control mode: -1 none, 0 FOLLOWING, 1 COMBINED, 2 LOCAL_TURRET, 3 REMOTE_TURRET, 4 LANDED, 5 WOW.
ship_ufoRotateX: Special X-axis rotation mode for UFO ships.
sv_achievProgressTimer: Minimum interval (s) for sending player progress to the achievement server.
event_newYear: Start time of the New Year event (ISO-8601).
event_custom: Start time of the custom event (ISO-8601); start and end must be whole hours or the 'imaginary' quest may misbehave.
sv_freeSynergyRewardCfPremiumVessel: Free-synergy reward coefficient for premium ships.
sv_goldMunitionExpRewardCf: Extra synergy-XP coefficient for kills/assists with gold munitions.
script_gcWorkBudget: Incremental Lua GC time budget per frame in microseconds.
sv_dailyWinPveExpRewardCf: XP multiplier for the first PvE win of the day.
sv_dailyWinPvpExpRewardCf: XP multiplier for the first PvP win of the day.
sv_dailyWinCoopExpRewardCf: XP multiplier for the first coop win of the day.
sv_dailyWinBrawlExpRewardCf: XP multiplier for the first brawl win of the day.
sv_pvpLabelChances: Per-rank (18 values, 0..1) chance of granting an event label (marks a ship as an event agent) in PvP.
sv_pveLabelChances: Same as sv_pvpLabelChances, for PvE missions and raids.
sv_rarePicksNumberWithFloatingChances: Number of attempts for choosing a rare loot table with floating chances (rare_limit).
sv_epicPicksNumberWithFloatingChances: Number of attempts for choosing an epic loot table with floating chances (epic_limit).
sv_overlootedRarePickChance: Base chance of picking the rare loot table.
sv_overlootedEpicPickChance: Base chance of picking the epic loot table.
sv_lootCommonPickChance: Base chance of picking the common loot table.
sv_lootMaxLevelRestriction: Restrict rare/epic loot tables to max-level ships only (bool).
sv_lootRuleCfA: Factor A of the rare/epic table weight: weight = max(0, A*(attempts-(it+Offset)) + B).
sv_lootRuleCfB: Constant B of the same weight formula.
sv_lootRuleCfOffset: Offset shifting the attempts threshold at which the floating rare/epic chance starts to grow.
sv_autorecordReplaysTo: Directory for dedicated-server replays; empty = disabled.
sv_kickExcessiveBotsEnabled: Kick players from a battle when bots outnumber players (bool).
sv_numBestPlayerToSave: How many best players' ships are saved for adaptive presets; -1 = all.
sv_minEfficiencyVesselToSave: Minimum ship efficiency (points) to be saved into adaptive presets.
sv_numAdaptivePresetsInDB: Limit of adaptive-preset records in DB per mode, rank and role; 0 clears.
sv_numUniqueAdaptivePresets: How many unique presets a dedicated server requests from the DB (0..100).
sv_rangeRankAdaptivePresets: Rank window for presets read from the DB, counted down from the queue's max rank (12 with value 3 -> ranks 9..12).
sv_leaveFineRewardCoef: Reward multiplier for players who left previous battles (0..1; 1 = no penalty).
sv_leaveCounterMaxDecay: Max amount by which the leave counter can decrease when the player gets a penalty.
sv_leaveCounterDecayWithoutFine: Amount the leave counter decreases when the player is not penalised (counter < 1).
sv_normalLeaveCounterAdd: Added to the leave counter on a normal exit ('Leave battle' button).
sv_abnormalLeaveCounterAdd: Added to the leave counter on an abnormal exit (crash, network loss).
sv_leaverReputationAdd: Added to leaver reputation when a leaver ban is issued (0..100).
sv_leaverBanTime: Minimum battle-ban time (s, 0..1800) for leaving; engine default 300.
sv_leaverReputationDecay: Leaver reputation decrease per battle without leaving.
sv_mmBattleRank: Battle rank of the match; passed to battle parameters and affects rank restrictions.
sv_eventObjectRespawnTimeMin: Minimum respawn time of an event object (s).
sv_eventObjectRespawnTimeMax: Maximum respawn time of an event object (s); min/max give the random delay range for the first and subsequent spawns.
sv_eventObjectEndTime: Time after which the event object is no longer created (ISO-8601).
sv_pickedLootRateToClanResource: Conversion rate of picked-up loot to clan resource (clan iridium).
sv_pickedLootUpdateTime: Interval (s) at which picked-loot iridium is sent to the clan.
sv_spaceStationPortalTimer: Timer of the portal to a station in open space (s).
sv_dbgAutogenDefs: Where to show seed chips: 1 in game only, 2 in game and hangar.
sv_enableCommunticationWithSS: Whether the zone instance talks to the scripts server (bool).
sv_ranksDiff: Rank-difference intervals (player rank - mob rank) for open-world damage scaling.
sv_ranksDiffCoeff: Damage scaling coefficients for the intervals of sv_ranksDiff.
ai_logSquads: AI squad logging: 1 spawn, 2 movement, 3 combat, 5 everything.
ai_convoyDefendRadius: Distance between the player and the despawn point for convoys.
sv_lootCrateScanTime: Scan time of loot crates in open space (s).
ai_kiteDistance: Max distance an AI squad may drift from its start point while chasing an enemy.
sv_aggressorMinNPCDamage: Damage dealt to a non-player target after which the player gets the aggressor flag.
sv_aggressorTimer: Maximum value of the aggressor-flag timer (s).
sv_resurrectionCreditsPrice: Credits price of resurrecting a player.
sv_instanceLifeTime: Seconds after which an empty zone instance is closed.
sv_freeSpaceExpMastery: Replacement ship mastery values for free space, per rank (18 values).
sv_freeSpaceExpRewards: Ship XP for combat in Free Space: 0 nobody, 1 premium only, 2 everyone; also limited by zone rank and sv_freeSpaceExpCap.
sv_expForDamageFreeSpace: Grant XP for damage in Free Space (bool, 'fast synergy gain').
sv_randomLootDef: Def name of the loot crate used by the random-loot system in Free Space; must be a LootCrate with isRare, otherwise random loot is disabled with a log error.
sv_owLabelChances: Per-rank (18 values) chances of granting label marks to ships in the open world.
sv_frendlyFactionDamageCoef: Damage coefficient against friendly-faction entities (0..1); affects damage only, other cvars affect relations.
sv_enemyMinFactionNPCDamage: Damage to non-player faction targets after which the faction becomes the player's enemy.
sv_factionBadRelationshipTime: Seconds during which the faction stays hostile after the player hit its NPCs.
sv_enemyMaxFactionNPCDamage: Max accumulated damage value for a faction-relation group (does not change real damage).
sv_enemyMaxFactionNPCDamagePerSec: Max damage per second counted for a faction-relation group.
sv_factionNPCDamageDecay: Decay rate of accumulated faction-NPC damage per second.
dbg_disableLuaDataFormatChecking: Disable Lua data format checking (e.g. zone playerLuaData) on conversion/saving; non-live builds only.
adventure_saveGiverOffers: Persist adventure-giver offers in the DB (bool).
mm_lowOnlineLo: Enter low-online mode when online is below this value.
mm_lowOnlineHi: Leave low-online mode when online is at or above this value.
mm_botsCount: Default number of bots (0..31); can be overridden per queue.
mm_defaultGameplay: Default gameplay id for a new session (see game-modes.md); can be overridden per queue.
mm_timeInQueueAveragingCf: Smoothing of the average time in queue (2..10000); ~10 dev/test, >100 live.
rate_exp: XP multipliers per rank, comma list (18 values).
rate_cred: Credit multipliers per rank, comma list (18 values).
reward_bonusGoldForWinner: Bonus gold given to battle winners.
reward_bonusGoldForLooser: Bonus gold given to battle losers.
reward_eventGoldTimePeriod: Period of the 'gold for first and fifth win' event: 'start;end' ISO-8601.
reward_eventGoldTimeValue: Event gold amounts per win slot, ';'-separated.
reward_leaveCounterMax: Maximum value of the leave counter.
lb_avgTimeMinClamp: Average queue time never goes below this.
lb_avgTimeAveragingCf: Number of last queued players used for the average time.
lb_minNextPlayerDelay: Load-balancer throttle: minimum delay between admitting players.
lb_maxTaskQLenOnShard: Load-balancer throttle: max task-queue length on a shard.
antispam_autobanAwareness: Awareness threshold above which a player is auto-banned in chat. Awareness grows with frequent/repeated messages and decays over time.
antispam_notifyAwareness: Awareness threshold at which the user is warned to stop spamming.
antispam_awarenessIntervalNumerator: Numerator A of the frequency term: gain = A/dt (dt = seconds since last message, min 0.5).
antispam_awarenessSimilarityMul: Factor K of the similarity term: gain = K*similarity^P (similarity = share of the message matching previous ones).
antispam_awarenessSimilarityPow: Exponent P of the similarity term.
antispam_trade_awarenessDecay: Trade chat: awareness decay per second.
antispam_trade_awarenessIntervalNumerato: Trade chat: numerator A of the frequency term.
antispam_trade_awarenessSimilarityMul: Trade chat: factor K of the similarity term.
antispam_trade_awarenessSimilarityPow: Trade chat: exponent P of the similarity term.
universe_unid: Id of the Universe in use (1..65535).
universe_newYearStartTime: Start time of the New Year event (ISO-8601, 'NY2016 params').
universe_empireKillsCF: Growth rate of the Empire kills counter.
universe_federationKillsCF: Growth rate of the Federation kills counter.
universe_jerichoKillsCF: Growth rate of the Jericho kills counter.
universe_factorOwnerInReward: Share of a zone's reward given to the current owner; the rest is split among rivals (0..1).
universe_decayOwner: Share of the owner's accumulated influence removed at conflict start (0..1).
universe_decayRival: Share of rivals' accumulated influence removed at conflict start (0..1).
universe_takeOwnerCoeffA: Coefficient A of the owner-penalty formula: rival contribution = influence/(A*place+B), place counted from 0.
universe_takeOwnerCoeffB: Coefficient B of the same formula.
universe_decayIdle: Share of accumulated influence removed after a conflict in which no new influence was added (0..1).
universe_allowExternalControl: Allow an external service to control zone logic; when disabled the server neither starts/ends conflicts nor accepts contributions (bool).
universe_raceFactorStellar: Clan influence bonus when its race matches the dominant race of the stellar system; multiplier = 1 + value.
universe_raceFactorZone: Clan influence bonus when its race matches the zone's race; multiplier = 1 + value.
war_coeffAssist: Global war: multiplier for assisting participants (final killer gets 1).
war_coeffRivalA: Global war: A in target multiplier = A*victimRank + B for a rival-corporation target.
war_coeffRivalB: Global war: B of the same formula.
war_coeffNeutral: Global war: target multiplier when the victim is not at war with the attacker's corporation.
war_coeffBot: Global war: target multiplier for a bot replacing a real player.
war_damageRawRateToMilitaryExp: Conversion of raw event points to military-rank progress.
war_damageRawRateToDamage: Conversion of raw event points to corporation damage on the global map.
war_decayCostBase: Periodic decrease of the base war cost, applied as multiplier 1 - value (0..1).
quests_readWaveMaxUids: Max number of UIDs loaded per DB read operation (1..1024).
quests_dbgLog: Quest debug-log bitmask: 1 caching, 2 availability, 4 user state, 8 quest selection, 16 progress; 31 = all.
quests_imaginaryRewardCoeffA: Imaginary-quest diminishing reward: amount = floor((A-1)*(1-tanh(B*(completions-1)))+1); A = initial reward.
quests_imaginaryRewardCoeffB: Speed of reward decay with completions; larger = faster.
achievements_readWaveMaxUids: Max number of UIDs loaded per DB read (1..256).
lobby_rewardRates: Multiplier applied to rewards of custom games.
lobby_reqPlayersPvEMin: Minimum players to start a PvE lobby.
lobby_reqPlayersPvEMax: Maximum players of a PvE lobby.
zc_enableZoneBlocks: Block zones on the raid schedule: ZoneCoordinator passes the flag to zone instances; in FreeSpace a raid zone is picked by schedule and jumps into it are forbidden.
tournament_idOffset: Offset of tournament team-name numbers in the UI (client uses string single_tournament_name_N).
tournament_gameInterval: Interval between game creations in ms (50..10000).
clan_shipPartsCanBuild: Number of main clan-ship (dreadnought) parts that can be built (0..4 stages).
clan_shipUpgradeCanBuild: Number of clan-ship module-upgrade stages available (0..3 = T3, T4, T5).
clan_shipBuildHighRanks: Number of high-rank (rank 9) members a clan needs to build the clan ship.
clans_historyMinResourceAddByZone: Minimum zone resource amount that is written to clan history (avoid log spam).
clan_warWinRewardAura: Reward aura/bundle for winning a clan war.
steam_useMicroTxnSandbox: Use Steam microtransactions in sandbox mode (shard.cfg).
